import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Mat {
        int[][] mat;
        int size;

        Mat(int size) {
            this.size = size;
            this.mat = new int[size + 1][size + 1];
        }

        Mat multiply(Mat other) {
            Mat res = new Mat(this.size);
            for (int i = 0; i <= this.size; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= this.size; ++j) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= this.size; ++k) {
                        sum += (long) this.mat[i][k] * other.mat[k][j];
                    }
                    res.mat[i][j] = (int) (sum % MOD);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long N = sc.nextLong();
        long K = sc.nextLong();

        int[] digits = new int[70];
        int count = 0;
        while (N > 0) {
            digits[count++] = (int) (N % K);
            N /= K;
        }

        int maxSize = (int) K;
        Mat[][] matrices = new Mat[64][30];
        Mat[][] prefix = new Mat[64][30];
        Mat[][] suffix = new Mat[64][30];

        for (int i = 0; i < K; ++i) {
            matrices[0][i] = new Mat(maxSize);
            for (int j = 0; j <= maxSize; ++j) {
                matrices[0][i].mat[j][j] = 1;
                matrices[0][i].mat[j][i] = 1;
            }
            matrices[0][i].size = maxSize;
        }

        // Initialize prefix[0][0]
        prefix[0][0] = matrices[0][0];
        // Initialize suffix[0][K-1]
        suffix[0][maxSize - 1] = matrices[0][maxSize - 1];

        for (int i = 1; i < maxSize; ++i) {
            prefix[0][i] = prefix[0][i - 1].multiply(matrices[0][i]);
        }

        for (int i = maxSize - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            suffix[0][i] = matrices[0][i].multiply(suffix[0][i + 1]);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < count; ++i) {
            matrices[i][0] = suffix[i - 1][0];
            for (int j = 1; j < maxSize; ++j) {
                matrices[i][j] = suffix[i - 1][j].multiply(prefix[i - 1][j - 1]);
            }

            prefix[i][0] = matrices[i][0];
            suffix[i][maxSize - 1] = matrices[i][maxSize - 1];

            for (int j = 1; j < maxSize; ++j) {
                prefix[i][j] = prefix[i][j - 1].multiply(matrices[i][j]);
            }

            for (int j = maxSize - 2; j >= 0; --j) {
                suffix[i][j] = matrices[i][j].multiply(suffix[i][j + 1]);
            }
        }

        Mat answer = new Mat(maxSize);
        answer.mat[0][maxSize] = 1;
        answer.size = maxSize;

        answer = answer.multiply(prefix[count - 1][digits[count - 1] - 1]);

        int lastDigit = digits[count - 1];
        for (int i = count - 2; i >= 0; --i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < digits[i]; ++j) {
                answer = answer.multiply(matrices[i][(j + lastDigit) % maxSize]);
            }
            lastDigit += digits[i];
        }

        long totalSum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= maxSize; ++i) {
            totalSum += answer.mat[0][i];
        }

        System.out.println(totalSum % MOD);
        sc.close();
    }
}
